title: Define exact cache replay and locale identity
objective: Define exact cache replay and locale identity; expected: summaries and prior output cannot bypass access.
acceptance_criteria: summaries and prior output cannot bypass access
The named outcome has actual source/build-bound evidence; unsupported, pending, failed and unperformed checks remain explicit.
decision: Full owner-supplied exact cache/recording identity, current native query/return authorization, source-qualified derived summaries, and distinct complete-recording Replay. Canonical checkpoint/source/access owners retain truth, publication and audience authority.

basis: canonical AcceptedDecision cause and source FactId/revision/operation/value/audience
listener identity and exact locale/template identity
source_identity.locale: Authored English bytes only. ASCII case normalization is supported by LocaleTag; dialects, aliases and reordered subtags do not become equivalent or trigger fallback.

authority: df-ai exact lookup and complete-record admission supply borrowed bytes and a complete candidate; the native courier, engine and DurableOwner retain current source/access validation and durable publication authority. Cache bytes and prior semantic_output grant no access.
replay: Complete recording Replay is a distinct exact-identity read with current source/request/access/mode authorization before storage and before every outcome. Missing/stale/storage failure/cancellation/current revocation never use prepared/live fallback. Durable receipt retry remains committed-operation recovery. Registered production AuthoredRecording still has no replay storage and refuses Replay/Live.

alternatives.alternative: Reuse by summary similarity, matching text, prefix or model/locale fallback
alternatives.decision: Rejected: derived prior output cannot establish current source/access/locale identity.

alternatives.alternative: Generic test-only store/authority or new cache DTO as production proof
alternatives.decision: Rejected as production proof; the bounded Design example instead uses actual canonical checkpoint records and native owner/source qualifications, while general storage/provider production gaps stay explicit.

alternatives.alternative: Requalify source mechanics or authorize private output from a critic
alternatives.decision: Rejected: current canonical source/audience owner retains authority.
Complete recording Replay contract and bounded owner example selected. Production replay storage, translation corpus and live providers remain explicit implementation gates.

gaps: No production general AI recording/cache database, retrieval index/provider executor, AiJob/AiResult/ExpressionContext schema freeze, tenant/auth or provider rights implementation is claimed. Existing owner-associated canonical types define the complete Design identity; no substitute canonical DTO/schema is introduced.

Native production courier remains fixed authored English prepared-only. Exact LocaleTag case normalization is supported; dialects/aliases/reordered subtags/translation/unknown voice or output parameters never trigger fallback or identity weakening.

Summary qualification is source-bound and deterministic for this admitted example, not a general natural-language contradiction classifier. Unknown arbitrary summarizer text is quarantined; derived/attributed text never becomes canonical facts or Rules authority.
Physical browser/device/audio, PostgreSQL restart, provider execution and paid-provider acceptance remain unperformed. Native demo membership is not production tenant authority.

Fresh complete prospective source/dependency/config/generated/tool/fixture freeze, native/WASM/style gates, immutable binary/full wire retention and independent/integrated Main acceptance are required. Source-authored tests alone make no PASS claim.
verification: Authored tests require fresh actual source/build-bound gates. This contract does not itself claim compilation, runtime acceptance, translation, provider execution, physical PostgreSQL restart, or production tenant authentication.
preserved_existing_coverage: Existing courier tests remain intact, including lost acknowledgement, uncertain lookup, corrupt/truncated/cancelled/trailing complete records and causal completion binding.

full_wire_witness.artifacts: Retain each actual complete encoded ViewMessage in protected worker namespace using exclusive files and exact hashes, plus role/source/mode/basis/case manifest. Witness is full encoded noninterference, not only empty clue or RESPONSE substring.
cases: source definition/policy withdrawal including successful empty view
malicious retained semantic/summary payload and private identifiers
full_wire_witness.implementation: Use actual wire::journey_view and prost::Message encoding for recipient/sibling/display. Pair valid restored checkpoints differing only hidden retained semantic/summary payloads. For every successful safe-empty projection, compare entire ViewMessage and exact encoded bytes across the pair; typed refusal branches expose no private identifier/text metadata.

exact_identity_dimensions: current access/index/source generations where supplied by owning request
exact LocaleTag and authored locale/template revision
supported output/voice parameters, or explicit unsupported discriminator
generic_identity.failure_and_rights: Missing, stale, unavailable, cancelled, revoked/unknown rights or unsupported parameters are typed and no-fallback. Authorized recording/cache lookup is not publication, disclosure, Rules truth or personal-payload retention permission. Invalidation never broadens access; retained references/derived bytes are refused on current revocation and deleted/redacted only by existing owner lifecycle.
generic_identity.generic_example: Existing canonical JobCompletion, RetrievalRequest, CheckpointPins, LocaleTag, AudienceScope and registered ContentReference form the bounded owner key/basis example. Mutate every independent payload/source/schema/job/run/generation/locale/projection/output dimension; full equality and current authority refuse stale entries before bytes escape.
generic_identity.implementation: Extend existing df-ai::lookup with ReadAuthority and lookup_authorized_prepared/lookup_authorized_replay. Before reading and before exposing ANY lookup outcome, owner reauthorizes current mode/job/run/source/access/audience. Existing PreparedRead owner Key:Eq/Basis:Eq remain canonical and compare the entire immutable entry; no replacement serialized schema or DTO.
generic_identity.native_refinement: Native private RecordingBasis binds actual canonical expected JobCompletion, current Basis, source FactId/revision/audience, AcceptedDecision cause and listener, complete pins/policy/model/locale. Its actual registered DEFINITION and JobOutcome::Ai shape identify the supported text contract; no invented access generation or voice codec is introduced. Actual recipient/source validation remains authority.
generic_identity.output_parameters: Only the canonical text JobOutcome::Ai payload shape and registered content contract are supported by this example. Voice synthesis/codec/style parameters and arbitrary translated output are unsupported and cannot be silently ignored or reused. A future owner must bind every supported parameter in its exact key/basis or refuse before read.

recording_replay.distinction: Durable receipt retry remains existing committed-operation recovery, never a generated-recording Replay surrogate. Production Replay/translation/provider/index owners remain implementation gates, while full Design matching and publication rules are defined and executable in the source-bound owner example.
recording_replay.implementation: Complete a real bounded RecordEvent stream through existing admit_complete_record/RecordingPublisher, install only after observed EOF and current owner validation, then read that distinct complete record through actual authorized replay port. RecordIdentity key/basis/operation, length/SHA and full owner cache binding are exact.
recording_replay.matching: Replay requires matching payload/source/context/contract/policy/model/run/job/generation/locale/audience/output identity and current projection rights. A miss, stale source, storage error, cancellation, bad finality or revoked current authority yields typed refusal with no prepared/live/provider fallback.
recording_replay.evidence_example: RecordingReplayOwner uses canonical RetrievalRequest/ContentReference/LocaleTag, full RecordingBasis and admitted JobCompletion; admit_complete_record observes EOF before owner installation, then lookup_authorized_replay reads only its distinct immutable entry under current native source/request/mode/rights.

summary_retrieval.implementation: Extend existing df-knowledge::ranking with a RetrievalOwner port and retrieve_ranked orchestration: current query authorization BEFORE bounded read; existing validate_batch/authorize_candidate BEFORE validation/cost/ranking; current reauthorization AGAIN before selected material returns. Canonical Request/Basis/Batch/Candidate associated types stay owned by caller.
summary_retrieval.limits: Existing RankingLimits and canonical RetrievalRequest item/byte/token bounds remain enforced; owner read port must use native timeout/deadline and storage bounds. No DB/provider/index implementation or new persistent schema is added.
summary_retrieval.native_example: Use actual MemorySummary/RetrievalRequest/MemoryEpisode/AttributedClaim/source facts in a validated native checkpoint. Source-bound owner validates observer membership/audience, exact request/source/index/access generations and provenance BEFORE returned-row use. Incomplete, revoked, stale or contradictory source-derived summary rows refuse; missing partial index remains explicit.
summary_retrieval.semantics: Summary provenance includes covered canonical episodes/claims, source_digest/source_revision and summarizer/model/policy/audience. Text remains derived, attributed and noncanonical. Bounded deterministic example requires exact source-backed text qualification rather than fabricating a general natural-language contradiction classifier. Summary text never becomes AcceptedFact/GameCommand/Rules effect; unsupported arbitrary summarizer qualification is quarantined.
summary_retrieval.evidence_example: NativeMemoryOwner uses actual canonical MemorySummary, MemoryEpisode, AttributedClaim and RetrievalRequest in validated checkpoints; retrieve_ranked authorizes before bounded deadline/read, before row qualification/cost/rank, and again before selected return.

selected_source_ports: registered native courier execute/recipient/source_recipient and complete-record admission
